summary: Implemented TimeElapsedColumn and the related Progress/Task/Palette changes, with tests and a changelog entry. Tests were not run, per instructions, so the hand-derived test_columns expected output is unverified. Files changed: rich/progress.py (new column, finished_time field, capture/clear logic, finished property), rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow), rich/palette.py (Palette.__rich__ with lazy imports), tests/test_progress.py (new column test, column list and expected output), tests/test_palette.py (new test_rich_cast), CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased section with two Added entries; the palette entry goes beyond the spec and can be removed). Grep checks confirmed the bar widths in the expected string (25 for the start frame, 16 for the finished frame). Nothing was committed. Next step: run pytest on tests/test_progress.py and tests/test_palette.py; if test_columns fails, check the expected string first.
